limitations: Does not repeat the complete swept triangle kernel or prove pickup, friction, assembly or robot motion.
Raw CAD samplers and common adapters are compared; complete upstream frameworks are not executed.
Raw endpoint Z can differ after horizontal projection; actual first-contact witnesses are checked on finite native pads and CAD triangles.
Original normals are retained in the intrinsic cache; they are not substituted for actual first-contact normal checks.
Runtime includes both conversion adapters and their two jaw assignments. Intrinsic sampling happens once per CAD; no pose-estimation, VLM or gallery time.
